answer: One tournament each epoch blocks fake identities. Entry costs 45 plus a 70-credit bond; entrants climb a vine bracket, filing a fresh key-tied proof each round. Auditors wander the vine; copied proofs burn bonds. Fees fill one ocean pool for finalists. The k-th identity from one operator pays 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500, locking 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented seats fail: no fresh proof. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeping its share.
